$comment: Council presets for ai-council-review. Data, not code: model slugs churn — fixing a deprecated slug is a one-line patch here. All slugs verified live against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-09-20 (council.mjs models --verify). See references/MODELS-CHANGELOG.md for roster history and the trigger behind each swap — models are external dependencies and sit outside this skill's semver contract. Users can override any of this via a repo .ai-council.json or ~/.config/ai-council-review/config.json. expectedOutputTokens are mean output tokens per review from 51 council runs with reasoning effort medium (2026-10-01 to 2026-11-02); the model's own entry wins, else reasoningDefault for a model that supports reasoning, else nonReasoningDefault. They only move the cost estimate; the hard cap uses maxOutputTokens.
